name: Forgotten Hollow
weather: Often cloudy, a chance of snow in winter, heat waves and thunderstorms in summer

highlights.name: Great for Night Owls!
highlights.text: The sun rises later and sets earlier here, meaning you can enjoy more hours of darkness

highlights.name: Local History
highlights.text: Tour relics of founders and meet residents that have “lived” here for generations

highlights.name: Unique Flora
highlights.text: Rare plants like Plasmafruit and the Sixam Mosquito Trap can be only found here

Straud.bio: Count Vladislaus Straud IV is the latest descendant to occupy Straud Mansion. His oddly similar looking line of ancestors has resided here since the founding of Forgotten Hollow.

Vatore.bio: The Vatore siblings moved into Forgotten Hollow a few years ago and are striving to make it their home. This can be quite challenging at times since they are not exactly on the best terms with Vladislaus Straud, but when asked they only ever mention a difference in their culinary tastes.

weatherSeasons.Spring: Partly cloudy, cloudy, chance of rain
weatherSeasons.Winter: Chance of snow, cloudy, partly cloudy
